day_shape: 77 items: CENTCOM says it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers and the M/T Riesco after IRGC missile attempts on a US warship, US Treasury sanctions 36 aviation-sector targets including all 27 Iranian airlines, UK lays new Iran sanctions legislation, Khamenei's office posts image of a captured US underwater drone.

threads.label: US-Iran naval clash in the Gulf
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it destroyed five Iranian crude oil carriers on 8 September and sank the M/T Riesco in the Gulf of Oman after two IRGC ballistic-missile attempts on a US Navy warship. Jerusalem Post reported explosions near Kharg Island and Iranian media claimed missile launches from 12 cities; IRIB relayed a UK Maritime Operations Centre incident notice.

threads.label: Captured US underwater drone claim
threads.summary: Iran claimed to have captured a Dive-LD autonomous underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz, with Khamenei's office posting an image and IRIB citing analysts calling it the seizure of the 'most advanced underwater surveillance equipment'. Jerusalem Post relayed the Iranian claim describing the vehicle's mine-countermeasures and seabed-mapping roles.

threads.label: US and UK sanctions expansion
threads.summary: The US State Department announced Operation Economic Outcast sanctioning 36 entities and individuals including all 27 remaining Iranian airlines, while the UK laid new legislation targeting energy, metals, banking, insurance and shipping. FCDO issued a written ministerial statement and a Notice to Exporters effective 29 September, and Federal Register recorded termination of INKSNA measures against an ROK entity.

threads.label: Iran economy under war pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported security forces deployed around fuel stations as a gasoline price rise took effect, exports to Afghanistan fell at least 25%, and a Jerusalem Post report described a US naval blockade squeezing Iranian oil exports. IRIB announced software adjustment of pumps to a 10,000-toman price and reported the Tehran stock index gaining over 47,000 units to 7.122 million.

threads.label: October 7 UAE warning dispute
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported that Netanyahu was personally warned by the UAE leader days before Hamas's 7 October 2023 attack and did not act; Netanyahu's office announced a libel suit against Haaretz over the claim. Jerusalem Post sources said the Biden administration was not aware of any specific UAE warning.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and West Bank arrests
threads.summary: The IDF said it destroyed three Hamas and Islamic Jihad weapon storage sites and a rocket-launch pit in Gaza, with further strikes reported in Sheikh Radwan and Khan Younis. Shin Bet, police and IDF announced the arrest of more than 30 suspects linked to a Hamas terror infrastructure in Jerusalem and the West Bank; a Jerusalem Post report said Hamas is working to reclaim weapons in Gaza.

threads.label: Yemen, Lebanon and regional fronts
threads.summary: UN Secretary-General Guterres condemned escalating Israeli operations in southern Lebanon and called for withdrawal, while Jordan's cabinet approved gas supplies to Lebanon via Syria and Israel's Navy chief warned Turkey and the Houthis. IRIB said Yemeni forces repelled a Saudi-backed ground offensive in al-Jawf; Jerusalem Post reported anti-Houthi strikes in Marib.
